Cyber police examine TMC bank transactions over five years

Cyber police are investigating five years of transactions in bank accounts linked to the Trinamool Congress (TMC). The Bidhannagar police have reportedly sought records from a private bank as part of this probe. The scope of the investigation appears to be focused on financial activities over the past half-decade.
